stories.headline: A shipwreck up to 4,700 years old still holds its cargo
stories.summary: Divers off Türkiye's coast found a small Bronze Age boat with about 18 intact jars and 3 stone anchors. Dated to 4,400–4,700 years ago, it may be the oldest shipwreck ever found.
stories.why: It sailed around the time the Great Pyramid was built.

stories.stat_label: possible planet born from a dead star
stories.headline: Hubble may have found a planet born from a dead star
stories.summary: A Jupiter-sized world may have formed from material cast off by a dying star, now a white dwarf. Clues in Hubble data from 1999 finally made sense after a new look.
stories.why: It solves a 27-year-old Hubble mystery about the star's strange chemistry.

stories.stat_label: years since Nebraska's last such find
stories.headline: A 6-year-old flipped a rock and found a rare ancient fossil
stories.summary: Leo Youngdahl hoped for a common fossil but found a conulariid, a jellyfish-like sea animal that lived 200–500 million years ago. Nebraska's only others were found over 55 years ago.
stories.why: He spotted something the experts had never seen at that site.

stories.headline: A wildlife bridge cut animal crashes on a highway by 91%
stories.summary: Drivers once hit an animal about once a day on this stretch of I-25. In the 10 months since North America's largest wildlife overpass opened, they have hit just 2.
stories.why: Elk, bears and even frogs now cross safely, and a pronghorn crossed for the 1st time in decades.

fun_fact: Amphorae, the jars found in the wreck, were the shipping containers of the ancient world for oil and wine.
